title: KainCheck curated Filipino food reference starter
sourceRelease: DOST-FNRI PhilFCT individual reports identify Release 1 December 2019; the report generation date is not a nutrient-data release date.
basis: All numeric values are per 100 g edible portion. servingGrams=100 is an editable reference weight, not a claim about a typical bowl, cup, piece or recommended serving. Multiply per100g values by the confirmed edible weight divided by 100. Missing data stays null.
limitations: This is a bounded, manually checked reference starter, not the full PhilFCT database. Values describe the exact source food variant and are estimates for a user's meal. Brand, recipe, seasoning, broth and edible portion can change nutrients substantially. Total sugar is not added or free sugar.
licenseStatus: Individual factual nutrient observations transcribed with attribution and source links. No complete tables or FNRI photos copied. The public FNRI pages did not expose a general redistribution/API license; obtain FNRI terms/permission before bulk database or photo reuse.

foods.name: Sinaing / white rice
foods.prepNote: Plain boiled reference; added salt, oil or toppings are separate. A cup is not automatically 100 g.

foods.name: Munggo, plain boiled
foods.sourceName: Mung bean seed, green, dried, boiled
foods.prepNote: Plain beans, not ginisang munggo with patis, pork, tinapa or broth. Seasoning and additions need separate entry.

foods.name: Pechay leaves, boiled
foods.prepNote: Leaves only; stalks and sauces have different records. A ginisa preparation needs its oil and seasonings included.

foods.name: Kalabasa, boiled
foods.prepNote: Plain boiled squash flesh; this is not ginataang kalabasa or squash leaves.

foods.name: Saging lakatan
foods.prepNote: Weigh peeled flesh. Natural total sugar is not equivalent to added/free sugar; do not apply an added-sugar warning to this number.

foods.name: Inihaw na bangus
foods.prepNote: Use edible cooked flesh, excluding bones. Marinade, salt, stuffing and dipping sauce can add sodium beyond this reference.

foods.name: Tinapang bangus
foods.prepNote: Smoked milkfish reference. Product salt content varies; use the package label when available. Exclude bones from weight.

foods.name: Chicken instant noodles, cooked
foods.servingLabel: 100 g of the cooked reference preparation
foods.prepNote: Not the dry packet. Water, seasoning packet and how much broth is consumed change the portion; prefer the exact product label.

foods.name: Hotdog
foods.prepNote: Source does not specify a brand or a fried cooking method. Extra frying oil and sauce are separate; prefer the current pack label.

foods.name: Pork longganisa
foods.prepNote: Longanisa, baboy in the source. Sugar was not reported, not zero. Brand, regional recipe and cooked weight vary.

foods.name: Karne norte / corned beef
foods.prepNote: Canned reference before added potatoes, onion or oil. Sugar was not reported. The brand label is preferable for a specific product.

foods.name: Leche flan
foods.prepNote: The report identifies the alternate name Leche flan. This is total sugar, not a separately measured added-sugar amount; caramel and recipe vary.

foods.name: Pancit molo with MLP
foods.variant: Prepared wonton soup with MLP, exact FNRI variant
foods.servingLabel: 100 g of the prepared soup reference
foods.prepNote: Preserve the source's MLP variant qualifier. Do not treat this as universal nutrition for all pancit molo recipes; broth and dumpling ratio matter.

foods.name: Pork adobo with egg, canned
foods.prepNote: Canned adobo with egg only. Never use this number as a verified estimate of homemade chicken or pork adobo.

foods.name: Pork afritada, canned
foods.prepNote: Apritadang baboy, de lata; this is not a verified record for a home-cooked afritada recipe.

foods.name: Dinuguan, canned
foods.prepNote: Dinuguan baboy, de lata. The source has no sodium value; do not label it low sodium or count missing sodium as zero.

foods.name: Sotanghon, plain boiled
foods.prepNote: Plain boiled noodles, without broth, meat, vegetables, soy sauce or oil. Do not use for a complete sotanghon guisado dish.

foods.name: Adobo, homemade
foods.variant: Chicken or pork recipe; ingredients required
foods.servingLabel: Editable edible weight; nutrients require recipe or label
foods.prepNote: Confirm chicken/pork, cooked edible weight, soy sauce/patis quantities, oil, sugar and sauce consumed. No homemade adobo nutrient report was verified during this bounded research.

foods.name: Tinolang manok
foods.variant: Home-cooked chicken, vegetable and broth recipe
foods.servingLabel: Editable cooked weight; nutrients require recipe
foods.prepNote: Confirm chicken edible weight, skin, vegetables, fish sauce/stock cube and broth consumed. Visual identification cannot measure hidden sodium.

foods.name: Sinigang
foods.variant: Protein, souring mix, vegetables and broth recipe
foods.servingLabel: Editable cooked weight; nutrients require recipe
foods.prepNote: Ask which protein, seasoning mix or tamarind, fish sauce, vegetables and amount of broth consumed. Different sinigang variants are not interchangeable.

foods.name: Pancit canton
foods.variant: Stir-fried noodle recipe, not plain dry noodles
foods.servingLabel: Editable cooked weight; nutrients require recipe
foods.prepNote: Confirm noodles, meat, vegetables, soy/oyster sauce and oil. Do not apply dry noodle values to an equal weight of prepared pancit.

foods.name: Lumpiang Shanghai
foods.servingLabel: Editable edible weight; nutrients require recipe
foods.prepNote: Confirm filling, wrapper, cooked weight, frying oil and dipping sauce; a photo cannot establish the recipe or serving mass.

foods.name: Sisig
foods.servingLabel: Editable edible weight; nutrients require recipe
foods.prepNote: Ask protein, cut, cooked weight, egg, mayonnaise, oil, soy sauce and seasonings. Do not fabricate one universal sodium figure.

foods.name: Pandesal
foods.variant: Bakery or packaged bread; label/recipe required
foods.servingLabel: Editable edible weight; nutrients require recipe or label
foods.prepNote: Use the bakery recipe or current package label and actual roll weight. Pan de leche is a different food and must not substitute for pandesal.
